{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Nigeria|Cuisine of Nigeria]]

'''Aadun''' is a snack common amongst [[Yoruba]]-speaking people of Nigeria.<ref>{{Cite web |last=9jafoodie |title=Adun}}</ref> There are two types of aadun: one made from pure corn flour and one made from corn flour mixed with palm oil and salt.

== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Corn Flour|corn flour]]
*{{frac|1|4}} [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|palm oil]]

*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
== Equipment ==
*[[Cookbook: Mixing Bowl|Mixing bowl]]

== Procedure ==

# Combine the corn flour, palm oil, chili pepper, and salt in a bowl.
# Leave the mixture to sit for 2–3 hours.
